summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting monthly securities and derivatives transactions held in treasury during May 2026, as mandated by Brazilian CVM Instruction 358/2002. The filing details share class A preferred share operations, with an opening and closing balance of treasury shares. There is no mention of any corporate transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. This is a routine compliance filing for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation event. No deal terms, advisors, or recommendations are present.
